description: What a kind of job pays in Finland, without needing a specific ad: the median and the usual range (25th to 75th percentile) of monthly gross pay for all of Finland, the big cities and remote work, with a link to the role's salary page. The same figures as the JobCrawls salary pages: Statistics Finland earnings for the occupation raised to today where the role has one (job ads only set the differences between cities), the stated pay in job ads otherwise. Fits questions like "how much does a nurse earn in Tampere" or "what does a barista make in Finland". Takes one to four roles in any language (several roles are compared side by side) and optionally an offer to place against the range. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

city.description: A city (Helsinki, Espoo, Tampere, Turku, Oulu...) or "remote". Omit for all of Finland.

offer.description: Only when the user named an amount: their offer or current pay, to place on the chart. Leave out otherwise.

offerPeriod.description: Whether the offer is per month or per year. Default month.

roles.description: Role names, e.g. ["full stack developer"] or ["barista", "waiter"].

name: pay_for_role

basis.description: Where the figures come from: source, as-of date and sample.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.

links.description: JobCrawls pages for the jobs and companies mentioned.

openInJobCrawls.description: A JobCrawls page with the full result.

title: Pay for a role
